badge_live_info: You hear this change right away.
badge_reconnect_info: GTA reads this from the audio files when you join: export, restart the server and reconnect to hear it.
door_aim_first: Look at a door first (hold right mouse to move the camera), then click again
door_not_found: That door isn't nearby. Walk closer and open the tool again.
export_blocked: FiveM blocked writing into %s (%s). Add this line to server.cfg, restart the server and export again: %s
export_no_room: %d placed sound(s) are not linked to a room, so the game treats them as outside sounds (%s). Stand in the room, move them (G) and export again.
found_mlo_json_files: Found %d saved MLO json files in [%s]
help_ambientZone: Optional ambient zone for extra background ambience. Usually empty.
help_archetype: The MLO name from your .ytyp. The game can't report it, so type it to get readable file contents. A wrong name is ignored and the hash is used instead.
help_distanceFromPortalFadeDistance: Metres over which occlusion fades in after that point. Default 50.
help_distanceFromPortalForOcclusion: Metres from a doorway before occlusion starts. 0 = right at the doorway.
help_door_preset: The sound set a door uses when it opens, closes and slams. Test opens the real door; the chosen sound is heard after export and reconnect.
help_el_ambient: A vanilla emitter is moved onto your point and keeps its own sound. Its original location goes silent while in use.
help_el_bank: Some sounds only play when their audio bank is loaded. Pick one if the sound stays silent.
help_el_hours: Game hours when it plays. 22 to 6 works across midnight. 0 to 24 = always.
help_el_pause: Random pause between repeats, in seconds, e.g. a dog barking every 20 - 60 s. 0 = continuous.
help_el_prop: Optional object spawned as the visible source. With a radio or emitter, the sound comes out of it.
help_el_radio: A free vanilla radio emitter is reserved and moved to your point, playing this station.
help_el_range: How far away you can hear it, in metres. The sphere in the world shows it while you edit.
help_el_static: While a player is within range, the vanilla emitter is muted (or switched on), then restored when they leave.
help_el_volume: Loudness in the exported game file (dB). Empty = default (+12 for radios / music, 0 for sounds). The editor preview plays at game volume.
help_export_group: Everything in this group is exported together: its interiors and placed sounds.
help_exteriorAudibility: How much of the outside world (traffic, rain, city) you hear in this room. 0 = sealed, 1 = like standing outdoors.
help_flags: Raw InteriorRoom flags. Keep 0xAAAAAAAA unless you know you need something else.
help_group: Name of the audio package. Rooms, doors, occlusion and placed sounds with the same group are exported together, usually one per MLO.
help_interiorType: Game category of the room. 0 works for nearly every MLO.
help_interiorWallaSoundSet: Crowd murmur for this room. Default hash_D4855127.
help_interior_flags: Raw InteriorSettings flags. Keep 0xAAAAA044 unless you know you need something else.
help_interior_reflections: Early reflections preset for the interior. Usually 0x00000000 (none).
help_interior_walla: Crowd murmur used for the whole interior. Default 0xD4855127.
help_nonMarkedPortalOcclusion: How much sound open doorways without a door or window block. 0 = passes freely, 1 = fully blocked. Default 0.7.
help_occlRoomName: Name of this room's entry in the .rel file. Leave empty to name it automatically.
help_outputs: What this interior adds to the export. Turn a part off if the MLO already ships its own file for it.
help_place_group: Group given to everything you place from now on.
help_portal_direction: Turn a direction off to stop sound travelling that way through this opening.
help_portal_entity: Door: blocks sound when shut, lets it through when open. Glass: lets some sound through even when shut. Max occlusion: how much it blocks when fully closed (1 = fully muffled).
help_proxy_override: Only for MLOs placed somewhere other than where the game reports them. Accepts a number, 0xHEX or hash_HEX.
help_rainType: Which rain-on-the-roof sound plays. 0 = the default.
help_reverbLarge: Long echo tail for big spaces such as warehouses, garages, tunnels. Typical 0 - 0.8.
help_reverbMedium: Body of the reverb for medium spaces such as shops, lobbies, stairwells. Typical 0 - 0.5.
help_reverbSmall: Short, close reflections: the sound of a small, hard room. 0 = none, 1 = strong. Typical 0.2 - 0.6.
help_roomOcclusionDamping: Extra muffling of sounds that reach this room from other rooms. Usually 0.
help_roomToneSound: Background loop you hear in this room: hum, air-con, fridge, crowd. Listen plays it here while you choose.
help_save_name: File name of this project in saved_interiors/.
help_weaponMetrics: How gunfire echoes in this room. Pick a game preset close to the room, or set your own values.
import_done: Read %d rooms, %d door sounds and %d portal entities
import_invalid: That text is not valid MLO tool JSON
import_nothing: No audio for this interior found in %s
layout_changed: The MLO layout changed since this file was saved (room or portal count differs). Settings were kept, but check the portals.
load_wrong_interior: That save belongs to a different interior
manifest_repatched: Audio lines added back to %s/fxmanifest.lua (refresh + restart it)
migrated_text: This file was made with format v%d and has been upgraded. Save to keep the new format.
no_filename_name_hash: No filename associated with name hash %s
nui_already_focused: Cannot bring up MLO Tool while NUI has focus somewhere else
pack_read_only: This element comes from a pack and is read-only
place_pick_first: Pick something in the Library first (TAB)
scan_done: Sound check done: %d sounds removed (not playable)
ui_after_export: Restart the server (or refresh + restart the resource) and reconnect: GTA reads audio files when you join.
ui_alarm_emitter: Alarm emitter: the alarm %s starts while it plays.
ui_checks_lead: Problems that would make the generated files wrong or sound odd in game.
ui_copy_folder: Copy %s into your resources and ensure it after the MLO.
ui_copy_lead: Reverb and occlusion values are copied. Each room keeps its own occlusion name.
ui_custom_emitter: Emitter name (also your own dat151 emitters)
ui_custom_object: Model name (also a prop from your MLO)
ui_door_add_aimed: + Add the door I'm looking at
ui_door_detect_info: Detect the door type by opening it
ui_door_test_info: Open and close the real door
ui_doors_lead: Choose the sound of each door. Test opens and closes the real door so you hear it. Door sounds lists every door, lift and garage sound to compare.
ui_doors_live_note: GTA can't swap a door's sound live: the chosen sound is heard after export, restart and reconnect. Test plays the door's current sound.
ui_export_json_lead: Copy this project to share it or keep a backup.
ui_export_lead: Writes native game files (no CodeWalker step): stream/<proxy>.ymt and audio/<group>_game.dat151.rel, plus a small script for sounds the game can't play on its own. A complete resource folder is always written to output/<group>/.
ui_freemove_active: Moving - release the mouse button to edit again
ui_hud_nothing: Nothing selected — TAB to open the panel
ui_import_json_lead: Paste a project exported from this tool. It must belong to the interior you are standing in.
ui_import_lead: Reads the .dat151.rel and .ymt the MLO resource already ships for this interior and loads their values here, so you edit what is really in game.
ui_install_none_info: Only output/<group>/. Copy it into your resources yourself.
ui_install_resource_info: Written into the MLO's resource and its fxmanifest is patched. Ships with the MLO.
ui_install_resource_perm: FiveM only lets a resource write into another with this server.cfg line:
ui_install_self_info: Written into the JDT resource itself. Restart the server and reconnect to hear it; nothing to copy.
ui_interior_bound_warn: Originally bound to the interior %s: it may be quieter or silent elsewhere.
ui_interior_only: Only when the player is in the same interior (no leaking outside)
ui_lib_lead_doorsounds: Door, lift, garage and turnstile sounds from the game, to compare by ear.
ui_lib_lead_emitters: Vanilla static emitters (club and bar music, TVs, alarms, crowds), moved onto your point.
ui_lib_lead_mute: Mute (or turn on) a vanilla emitter while players are near, e.g. music leaking into your MLO.
ui_lib_lead_objects: Any game prop, on its own or as the visible source of a sound.
ui_lib_lead_radios: Every radio station, including hidden club and casino ones.
ui_lib_lead_sounds: 3,700+ positional sounds. ▶ plays it next to you; click a row to set it up and place it.
ui_limbo_info: Outside (limbo) is everything beyond the interior. It has no acoustic settings, but portals to it decide how much of the street you hear inside.
ui_live_edit_note: Live: every change plays in the world right away. Save keeps it for everyone, Revert goes back.
ui_map_lead: Rooms laid out from above. Click a room to edit it, click a line to open that portal. Numbers show how many rooms away from outside each room is.
ui_mirror_info: Mirror portals are skipped in the occlusion file.
ui_no_doors: No doors found. Look at one and use + Add.
ui_not_in_room: You are not standing in a room of this interior
ui_notes_placeholder: Anything worth remembering about this interior
ui_nothing_placed: Nothing placed yet: pick something in the Library, aim and press E.
ui_now_playing_empty: Press ▶ on anything to hear it here.
ui_outside_lead: You can browse the library, place sounds, radios and objects anywhere, and export. Walk into an MLO to edit its rooms, portals and doors.
ui_overview_lead: Name the audio package, choose what it generates and read the audio the MLO already has. Everything saves when you close the tool.
ui_pack_export_lead: %d elements. Ship this file with an MLO and list it in Config.Packs.
ui_perm_needed: FiveM blocked the write. Add to server.cfg, restart, export again:
ui_placed_lead: Everything placed on this server. ▶ / ❚❚ pauses one for you only, Solo plays just that one. Click a row to edit it live.
ui_portal_no_entities: No entities associated with this portal
ui_portals_lead: Each portal connects two rooms. Turn off a direction to stop sound travelling that way, and mark doors and glass so they muffle sound.
ui_portals_live_note: Portal and occlusion changes are heard after export and reconnect. Use the outlines and the map to check them now.
ui_preview_empty: Pick a file above to preview it before generating.
ui_prop_place_tip: Aim where it goes, rotate with ← → and raise or lower with Shift + wheel.
ui_proxy_override_placeholder: Leave empty to use the calculated hash
ui_rebuild_confirm: This rescans the interior from the game and resets every room and portal to the defaults. Your saved file is only replaced when you save.
ui_factory_info: Puts every setting back to default: theme, window size and position, overlay options, emitter view, auto-select and floor plan layouts. Your placed sounds, audio projects, saved locations and entity sets are kept.
ui_factory_done_info: Every setting is back to default.
ui_sc_aim: While aiming: place, listen, move, edit, delete
ui_sc_freemove: Hold to walk and look around
ui_scan_once_text: It plays every sound for a split second (about a minute, lower your volume) and hides the ones that don't play. Saved on the server for everyone.
ui_scan_tip: Stand still and keep the game focused.
ui_search_sounds: Search: fridge, aircon, neon, walla, fountain…
ui_settings_lead: These settings are stored on your PC only.
ui_show_help: Explain every setting (help text and Live / After reconnect badges)
ui_sound_failed: That sound didn't play (it probably needs an audio bank)
ui_tone_search: Search: room tone, aircon, neon, fridge, walla…
ui_uninstall_confirm: Remove the exported files of “%s”? Your project and placed sounds stay.
ui_walk_in_text: Rooms, portals, doors, the map and checks are read from the interior you stand in.
unrecognized_interior: Not currently in a recognized MLO interior
val_archetype_mismatch: The archetype name “%s” does not hash to this interior, so the hash name is used. Check the spelling in your .ytyp.
val_archetype_unknown: Archetype name not set - the dat151 file will use %s. That works, but typing the real name gives readable output.
val_door_no_sound: %s is a door but has no door sound. Add it on the Doors tab.
val_duplicate_occl: Occlusion name "%s" is used by %s and %s. Every room needs a unique name.
val_element_no_room: “%s” is not linked to a room: in the exported file the game treats it as an outside sound. Move it (G) while standing in the room.
val_entity_door_glass: Portal %d: %s is marked as both door and glass
val_entity_zero_occlusion: Portal %d: %s has 0 max occlusion, so it will never block sound
val_no_portals: This interior has no portals - audio occlusion cannot be generated
val_no_rooms: This interior has no rooms besides outside
val_nothing_exported: Every output of this interior is turned off, so it adds nothing to the export.
val_portal_connector: Portal %d links to another interior. Cross-interior occlusion is written as a normal portal.
val_portal_disabled: Portal %d is disabled in both directions
val_portal_needs_geometry: Portal %d has no geometry yet. Stand in the interior and open the tool to rescan it.
val_room_dry: Room %d (%s) has no reverb at all
val_room_no_portals: Room %d (%s) has no portals - sound can't reach it
val_room_too_deep: Room %d (%s) is %d rooms from outside; paths stop at %d
val_room_unreachable: Room %d (%s) can't be reached from outside with the enabled portals
write_output_fail: Failed to write to output file
export_missing_zone: Rooms point at an ambient zone that is not in this export (disabled, deleted or in another group): %s
import_zones: Created %s ambient zones from the MLO's audio (see Placed)
val_custom_missing: Room %s uses custom sound %s, which does not exist (deleted or renamed?)
val_room_zone_external: Room %s points at zone %s, which is not placed with this tool. The game only finds it if it is in the same audio file.
val_room_zone_missing: Room %s points at an ambient zone that no longer exists
val_room_zone_other: Room %s uses zone "%s", which is disabled or in another group, so it will not be exported with this interior
val_zone_empty: Ambient zone "%s" has no sounds yet
ui_cant_decode: This file could not be read as audio
ui_custom_script_hint: From a script: RequestScriptAudioBank('%s', false) then PlaySoundFromCoord(-1, '%s', x, y, z, '%s', false, 20, false)
ui_drop_title: Drop audio files here or click to choose
ui_drop_text: mp3, ogg, wav, flac… converted to the game's format for you (up to %s MB each)
ui_loop_sound: Loop (plays continuously, for room tones and hums)
ui_lib_lead_custom: Your own audio files, packed into the game's format on export. Use them for placed sounds, room tones, zone sounds and emitters.
ui_lib_lead_zones: An area that plays ambience while you are in it: sounds that repeat at random spots, hours, rain, and the game's own ambience.
ui_no_custom: No custom sounds yet. Drop a file above.
ui_no_rules: No sounds yet. Add one below.
ui_no_sample: No recording for this preset yet (samples/doors/)
ui_normalize: Raise quiet files to full level
ui_play_sample: Play a recording of this preset
ui_quiet_file: This file is very quiet; consider Normalize or a higher volume
ui_search_rules: Search vanilla rules: birds, ac, fridge, crowd…
ui_tone_not_loop: This sound is not set to loop; a room tone should loop
ui_vanilla_rules_lead: Ready-made sounds from GTA's own ambient zones (fridges, AC units, birds, crowds…). Add them to a zone; you hear them after export and reconnect.
ui_zone_box_info: Rooms, halls, yards: width × length × height, rotatable
ui_zone_sphere_info: Round areas: a radius around a point
help_custom_loop: Loop: the sound plays on and on (room tones, hums, music beds). Off: it plays once each time it is triggered (zone rules repeat it).
help_custom_settings: Packed on export: ADPCM is what the game uses and 4× smaller; lower sample rates save memory. Heard in the panel now, in the game after export + reconnect.
help_custom_upload: Files are converted in the panel to 16-bit mono WAV and stored in sounds/<group>/ on the server. You can also drop .wav files into that folder and press Rescan.
help_door_custom: Your own door entry: the game's door sounds, how the door moves, and how much it blocks sound when shut (0% = open hole, 100% = solid wall).
help_emitter_native: Used when this element is exported as a native emitter (radios, plain looping sounds). Empty = game default.
help_room_ambience: An ambient zone the game plays while you are in this room, the way vanilla interiors do. Create one in Library > Ambient zones.
help_zone_intro: Place a zone, then add sounds: each repeats at random spots inside it (or a fixed spot), within its hours. You hear your sounds live while editing; game rules after export.
help_zone_volume: Inner box/sphere: where sounds spawn. The switch-on margin around it is where the zone starts working.
help_zone_rules: Each sound repeats every N seconds plus a random extra, between the spawn distances from you. 0 seconds with a looping sound = constant hum.
help_zone_vanilla: References to GTA's own ambient rules; they bring their own sounds and timing.
help_zone_dir: GTA's directional ambience beds (birds, crickets, city) at the given volume.
help_zone_scene: An audio scene (mix change) active while you are in the zone, e.g. muffled music.
help_zone_env: Environment reverb rule while inside (rarely needed).
help_zone_rooms: Rooms of this interior that play this zone while you are in them (InteriorRoom ambient zone).
help_weaponWetness: How much echo gunshots get (0 dry, 1 very echoey).
help_weaponVisibility: How far the gunshot is heard outside the room.
help_weaponLpf: Brightness of the echo; lower = duller.
help_weaponPreDelay: Time before the echo starts; bigger rooms have longer delays.
help_weaponHold: How long the echo tail holds.
ui_scan_reset_confirm: Forget the sound check and the sounds you hid by hand. Every sound shows again until you run the check again.
ins_teleport_disabled: Teleporting is disabled on this server
ui_card_entities: Scan, hide, fade and box any object; YMAP flags and copy helpers.
ui_card_locations: Live coordinates, saved positions and safe teleport.
ui_portal_overlay_shared: Show portals in world (same overlay as MLO › Portals)
placement_found: This MLO is placed %s times. Every copy gets its own occlusion file on export; export again to include this one.
ui_placement_remove: Forget this placement (its .ymt is no longer exported)
